questions.question: What are nutrients? Name the main nutrient groups.
questions.expected_answer: Nutrients are the substances in food that our bodies need to work, grow and stay healthy. The main groups are carbohydrates, proteins, fats and oils, and vitamins and minerals.

questions.question: What do carbohydrates and proteins do? Give two foods rich in each.
questions.expected_answer: Carbohydrates give the body energy; examples are maize meal, rice, bread, potatoes, fruit and honey. Proteins help the body grow and repair damaged parts; examples are meat, fish, eggs, milk, beans, peanuts and soya.

questions.question: What do fats and oils, and vitamins and minerals, do for the body? Give an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: Fats and oils give and store energy, insulate the body to keep it warm and protect organs; examples are cooking oil, butter, peanuts and avocado. Vitamins and minerals are needed in small amounts to keep us healthy and protect us from disease; for example vitamin C in oranges keeps gums healthy, calcium in milk builds bones and teeth, and iron in spinach helps the blood carry oxygen.
